title: Evaluation of the search circuit
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers, and let $(D_j)_{j\in\mathbb N}$ be a family of Boolean circuits, with $D_j$ taking $n+j$ input bits. If every $D_j$ is well formed and has fan-in at most two, then for every input $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, the search circuit built from the family outputs exactly the list produced by the sequential bit search on the bit list of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: Every circuit $D_j$ is well formed and has fan-in at most two
